content.short: Validation Cloud offers institutional node APIs, staking and data products for digital assets.
content.description: Validation Cloud combines a high-performance node API with enterprise staking and a data-and-AI product line, aimed at institutions that want one provider across all three instead of stitching together separate vendors. Non-custodial staking covers major proof-of-stake protocols, and its Mavrik product applies AI to the same chain data. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and supports stablecoins and tokenized assets alongside ordinary crypto workloads. It appears as a supported RPC provider in the documentation for both Monad and Robinhood Chain.
